title: SessLint Hook Result Format v1
description: Content-free result emitted by `sesslint hook --json` (agent-hooks T-01): the event, verdict, skip/findings reason, per-code finding counts, and hash-truncated session identifier. Carries no payload values — hook stdout may be injected into agent context.

event.description: Hook event name passed via --event (e.g. SessionStart, SessionEnd).

reason.description: Outcome reason: clean, findings-present, detection-failed, or a skip reason (malformed-payload, payload-too-large, no-transcript-path, transcript-not-found, io-error, usage-error, internal-error).

findings_by_code.description: Sorted map of emitted finding codes to counts; empty on ok/skipped.

top_code.description: Highest-severity emitted code (ties break alphabetically); present only on verdict=findings.

session_id.description: SHA-256 hash-truncated (8 hex chars) session identifier from the hook payload, when present — an identifier, never content.
